blocks.title: Lead response test: no reply after 5+ minutes
paragraphs: We sent a message through the website chat. More than 5 minutes later, nobody had responded.

The 2007 MIT/InsideSales Lead Response Management study found that contacting a web lead within 5 minutes instead of 30 gave 100 times the odds of reaching them and 21 times the odds of qualifying them.

sections.title: 7. Legal and compliance risk
sections.lead: The site has no privacy policy, terms and conditions or accessibility statement.

blocks.text: What it can cost: real examples

rows: Plaintiff firms scan small-business websites and send demand letters or file suit.
An Orlando flower shop paid $7,000+ in late 2024. Average out-of-court settlement: about $25,000–$30,000.
Follow-up texts sent without documented consent (TCPA).
$500 per text, up to $1,500 if willful.

blocks.text: Not legal advice; have a licensed attorney review final policies. Re-verify all figures before each report.
